notes.note: An instrumental Karma Police b-side, all sitar drone and supermarket-fluorescent unease.
notes.reasoning: Claim: 'Meeting in the Aisle' is an instrumental Karma Police b-side. Wikipedia lists it as a B-side of the 1997 Karma Police single, and reviews describe it as an instrumental. Sitar-drone/fluorescent-unease imagery is subjective.

evidence.snippet: Single by Radiohead from the album OK Computer - B-side: "Meeting in the Aisle"; "Lull"; - Released: 25 August 1997
You get a defining anthem (Karma Police), a boundary-pushing instrumental (Meeting in the Aisle), and a hazy, pretty closer (Lull).
